Source: Philippine Competition Commission (PCC) — press release "PCC adjusts the merger
notification thresholds effective March 2026" (2 March 2026). Verbatim excerpt:
https://www.phcc.gov.ph/resource-details/pcc-adjusts-the-merger-notification-thresholds-effective-march-2026

Effective 1 March 2026, the PCC increased the merger notification thresholds: the Size of
Party (SOP) threshold from P8.5 billion to P9.1 billion, and the Size of Transaction (SOT)
threshold from P3.5 billion to P3.8 billion. Both thresholds must be met for a transaction
to be considered notifiable under Section 17 of Republic Act No. 10667.
